create_CubeReorient_env: create a CubeReorient environment instance with default config for reorienting a cube with a leap hand robot
build_default_config: build a default configuration dict for the CubeReorient leap hand reorient task with reward and perturbation settings
run_domain_randomize: run domain randomization on a mjx model to vary friction, mass, inertia, and joint parameters for robustness
test_CubeReorient_reset: test the CubeReorient reset method to initialize the environment with randomized goal orientation and cube pose
review_CubeReorient_step: review the CubeReorient step method that applies control, steps physics, computes rewards, and handles perturbations
